answer.says: Ramesh, the heat has broken. The grey is a mercy. Do not let Shri Hegde disturb me before ten; I must finish this thought on the state before his arrival. And bring my spectacles from the study.
answer.thought: The overcast sky is a pause in the sensory assault, a blank canvas upon which the mind can project its own structures without the interference of the immediate. I have returned from the gardens with the dust of the tombs on my mind and the reality of the bungalow in my bones. Shri Hegde is a complication, a particularity that must be managed, but the universal logic of the day proceeds regardless of his presence.
